title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that all three processes are impossible.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the conservation of energy and momentum for each process.

title: Invariant Mass Argument
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the invariant mass squared concept to support their reasoning for each process.

title: Detailed Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a detailed explanation of why energy and momentum cannot be conserved in each case.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as misapplying conservation laws or neglecting factors in calculations.
